title: Harborline Early Renewal Credit on Web Hosting Plans
content:
Harborline early renewal credit — Web Hosting Plans.

The early renewal amount is reduced by Harborline's early renewal credit for a renewal paid at checkout while the plan's auto-renew is switched off, set by the whole calendar days from today to the term end date: 30 days or more ahead earns USD 10.00; fewer than 30 days ahead earns USD 4.00; a plan whose auto-renew is switched on earns no early renewal credit.

| Plan's auto-renew setting | Whole calendar days from today to the term end date | Early renewal credit |
|---|---|---|
| off | 30 or more | USD 10.00 |
| off | 29 or fewer | USD 4.00 |
| on | any | none |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical term end date 31 August).**

- Auto-renew off, today 1 August: 30 days ahead — USD 10.00.
- Auto-renew off, today 2 August: 29 days ahead — USD 4.00.
- Auto-renew on, today 1 June: no early renewal credit, however far ahead.
